title: 2008 Calumet: the Hanford house checked against its 1883 drawing
items: The Hanford house at 2008 Calumet Avenue has been matched against its 1883 drawing. Its south side now has the round oriel window on carved brackets, and a projecting bay with three windows on each floor that rises to a stone gable. The chimneys and side windows are where the drawing puts them, the pointed corner roof covers the whole corner block, and the stone is rough-faced, as drawn.
